summary: iter233 tested on both web + mobile with cathy@example.com. Backend: 6/6 pytest PASS — POST /api/invoices/{id}/letter (draft-all) returns entry_id + issue_count + editor_path=/tools/letters-and-follow-ups/{entry_id}; 401 unauth; 404 unknown invoice; GET /api/invoices lists 33 seeded rows with provider_name+created_at fields (filter-ready); GET /api/lf1/correspondence returns entries (14+); GET /api/lf1/follow-ups returns {overdue,upcoming}. Web: /app/letters has letters-new-btn (14 LF-1 letter-{id} rows visible, click navigates to /ai-tools/letters-and-follow-ups); /app/invoices filters all present (invoices-search-input, provider (2 options: Glorious/Meridian), period, status (4 options)); typing 'zzzz' shows invoices-list-no-results + invoices-clear-filters + 'result-count=0 of 33 shown'; clearing resets to '33 shown'; status=issues narrows to '5 of 33'; inv1-draft-all-btn present on /app/invoices/{id} and one-click navigates to /tools/letters-and-follow-ups/{new_entry_id} (Correspondence editor loads with Archetype=Escalation, ACQSC recipient, Pre-fill panel). Mobile: /letters letters-new works (routes to /tool/letters-and-follow-ups); /invoices filter-bar+search+status chips (all/issues/all_clear)+provider chips (Glorious/Meridian) all render, fake search shows invoices-list-no-results; /invoice/{id} shows inv1-draft-all-btn on the seeded invoice (18 issues, refund $180.86). Parity across web + mobile is intact. Two minor observations flagged below, no blockers.

ui_bugs.issue: inv1-draft-all-btn not present on /tool/invoice-checker (upload landing screen). Expected only after an invoice with >1 finding is uploaded/loaded — so this may be by design, but I could not confirm the button appears mid-flow without seeding an active result in the tool. Web has the same behaviour (btn not present on /ai-tools/invoice-checker landing).

action_items: (Verify manually) On web + mobile Invoice Checker Tool pages the inv1-draft-all-btn should appear after an invoice with >1 finding is loaded — not testable via automation without a fresh upload. Backend endpoint is confirmed working end-to-end.

(Optional carry-over from iter232) Mobile draft-all tap → Alert.alert('OK') → router.push('/correspondence') can't be observed in automated Expo web preview (RN Web Alert renders custom UI). Consider adding testID on the OK button to enable full E2E automation.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/routes/invoices.py:556 create_letter_from_all_findings correctly aggregates every finding into source_import.issues[] + issue_count and routes to situation 10 when any finding escalates to ACQSC (else situation 3). Uses uuid4 for entry_id and inserts into lf1_correspondence with archetype='escalation' or 'dispute'. HTTP 400 for zero-finding case is correct.

InvoiceFilters.jsx: MultiSelect + SingleSelect both use click-outside listeners with useRef + document.mousedown — clean; each option carries a stable data-testid (invoices-<name>-filter-option-<value>). Result count is rendered ml-auto with tabular-nums and only shows '{n} of {total} shown' when filtered — good affordance. Consider debouncing search input for very large lists (33 is fine here).

LettersMailbox.jsx correctly separates LF-1 entries (letter-{id} → /tools/letters-and-follow-ups/{id}) from LF-2 auto-generated chains (rendered below), preserving legacy while migrating UX. draftNew() navigates to /ai-tools/letters-and-follow-ups (tool landing) — matches mobile parity. Empty state includes letters-empty-draft-btn — great redundancy.

Draft-all letter web flow: caregiver clicks inv1-draft-all-btn on /app/invoices/{id} → POST /api/invoices/{id}/letter → 200 with entry_id → navigate to /tools/letters-and-follow-ups/{entry_id}. Editor loads with pre-fill panel showing linked Price check + Contribution estimate and correct participant name (Dorothy Smith) — end-to-end integration is solid.
